verdict.rationale: The evidence points to a versioned release model: an official upgrade guide (angular-gh-3) and an `ng update` command that updates the workspace and its dependencies (angular-docs-15). Nothing in the pack describes a deprecation policy, deprecation timelines, or semver/LTS guarantees. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy, an explicit API versioning or semver commitment, support/LTS windows, and independent corroboration of upgrade stability.
